security_audit.summary: The two external command findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code spans around a document name. The high entropy heuristic is also a false positive because SKILL.md is plain Japanese Markdown, with no encoded payload or binary content. No evidence found for prompt injection, data exfiltration, or hidden execution intent.

static_findings.snippet: - **詳細仕様**: UI/UX の詳細な設計指針・コンポーネント仕様は `UIUX.md` を参照
- **変更時の記録**: UI/UX に関わる設計判断・変更は必ず `UIUX.md` に記載・更新すること

static_findings.pattern: [HEURISTIC] High file entropy (6.65 bits) - possible binary/encrypted content

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 27 uses backticks as a Markdown inline code span around UIUX.md. It does not define Ruby code, shell execution, or a command invocation.
Line 28 uses backticks as Markdown formatting for the UIUX.md file name. There is no executable syntax, interpreter directive, or user-controlled command path.
SKILL.md is readable Markdown with YAML front matter and Japanese text. I found no binary blob, encoded payload, encrypted block, or concealed instruction.

content.value_statement: UI/UX work often drifts when teams lack shared principles and review habits. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a concise checklist for design decisions.
actual_capabilities: Applies user-centered design principles to interface reviews.
Checks consistency across design patterns and interactions.
Prompts attention to WCAG accessibility and responsive layouts.
Reviews design system basics, including components, colors, typography, and spacing.
Evaluates interaction states, including feedback, errors, loading, and microinteractions.
Directs design decisions and changes to UIUX.md documentation.
limitations: It provides guidance only and does not run design tools.
It does not include project-specific component specifications.
It references UIUX.md, but that file is not included in this skill package.
It cannot verify live accessibility results without project files or test output.

use_cases.title: Review a Product Screen
use_cases.description: Assess a screen for consistency, accessibility, responsive behavior, and clear interaction states.

use_cases.title: Prepare Design Handoff Notes
use_cases.description: Organize UI decisions into clear documentation before engineers implement a feature.

use_cases.title: Audit Frontend Changes
use_cases.description: Check a feature branch against shared UI principles before release.

prompt_templates.title: Basic UI Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one screen or flow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the uiux-ops skill to review this screen for user goals, consistency, accessibility, and responsive behavior. Give prioritized recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Interaction State Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of behavior and feedback.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the uiux-ops skill to evaluate feedback, error handling, loading states, and microinteractions for this workflow. Identify missing states.

prompt_templates.title: Design System Alignment
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review against shared UI standards.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the uiux-ops skill to compare this design against our component, color, typography, and spacing standards. Note decisions for UIUX.md.

prompt_templates.title: Release Readiness Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced audit before shipping UI changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the uiux-ops skill to audit this UI change for accessibility, responsive layout, interaction completeness, and documentation gaps. Return release blockers first.

output_examples.input: Review a checkout form before release.
output_examples.output: The review flags unclear error messages, missing loading feedback, and inconsistent spacing. It recommends documenting final form rules in UIUX.md.

output_examples.input: Check a new dashboard card pattern.
output_examples.output: The review compares component reuse, color meaning, type scale, and spacing. It lists alignment issues and suggested design system updates.

output_examples.input: Prepare notes for a responsive mobile update.
output_examples.output: The review identifies breakpoint risks, touch target concerns, and content priority changes. It suggests concrete notes for the design record.

best_practices: Provide screenshots, flows, or feature context before asking for a review.
Ask for prioritized findings when release timing matters.
Update UIUX.md whenever a design rule or exception changes.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the checklist as a substitute for user research.
Do not skip accessibility review for internal tools.
Do not leave design decisions only in chat history.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps review UI/UX decisions using shared principles for consistency, accessibility, responsive design, and interaction quality.

faq.question: Does it create visual mockups?
faq.answer: No. It provides review guidance and documentation prompts, but it does not generate design files.

faq.question: Can it be used with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What files does it depend on?
faq.answer: The skill content references UIUX.md for detailed specifications and change records.

faq.question: Is it suitable for accessibility reviews?
faq.answer: Yes, it prompts WCAG-aware review, but final validation should use real content and accessibility testing.

faq.question: Is this a security-sensitive skill?
faq.answer: No direct execution, network access, or secret handling was found in the reviewed SKILL.md file.
